hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *backend/app/services/ai_*|*backend/app/prompts/*) echo "[REQUIRE] AI Layer change — verify prompt caching, model choice, and cost (manifest-pitch-reel-cost-guard, /claude-api)." ;; *backend/app/auth/*|*backend/app/security/*|*backend/app/services/payment*|*backend/app/services/legal*) echo "[REQUIRE] Sensitive surface change — run /security-review on staged diff before commit." ;; *supabase/migrations/*) echo "[REQUIRE] Migration touched — review lock impact and rewrite rules before commit (manifest-supabase-migration-safety)." ;; *backend/app/graphql/*|*schema.graphql) echo "[REQUIRE] GraphQL contract may have changed — run manifest-docs-sync to keep docs/ aligned." ;; *backend/app/guest_session*|*backend/app/services/guest*) echo "[REQUIRE] Guest session logic touched — run manifest-guest-session-guard and add/update tests." ;; *backend/*.py) echo "[hint] Run /simplify; if you also touched the AI Layer also run /claude-api." ;; *frontend/src/components/*.tsx) echo "[hint] Run /simplify; consider an a11y check on interactive components." ;; esac'

bash -c 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$staged" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$staged" | grep -qE "(auth|security|services/payment|services/legal|guest_session|schema\.graphql)"; then echo "[gate] Sensitive files staged — run /security-review before committing."; fi; if echo "$staged" | grep -qE "(schema\.graphql|backend/app/routes|\.env\.example)"; then echo "[gate] Public contract changed — run manifest-docs-sync to update docs/."; fi; exit 0'
